stations.name: TOWER WEATHER
lines: Tower weather. It is currently the weather. Expect more of it later.
Wind: from the east, then from the south, then from the east again.

stations.name: BELLWETHER FM
lines: Bellwether FM, where the hits just keep coming. This one is a hit. Probably.
And now, a song you will not remember hearing. Enjoy.

stations.name: TRAFFIC NOW
lines: Traffic now. There is no traffic. There has never been traffic. Please do not look for it.
In other news, a pigeon has been elected to the school board.

stations.name: THE DAY AFTER
lines: ...rain. Tomorrow's rain. It is raining today too. Please bring two umbrellas.
The Clean State thanks you for your cooperation. Cooperation is mandatory beginning... yesterday.

objects.text: A shelf of radios. Each one is tuned to a different station. Each one is playing the same sentence.
Cables. So many cables. One of them is plugged into another cable which is plugged into the first.
